rules.rationale: A single current measure is represented by a KPI scorecard.
Current value and target belong in a KPI card; bullet charts are not registered yet.
Ordered time and a numeric measure support a precise trend line.
Area emphasizes volume; line is preferred when precision matters.
Bars support readable ordered category comparison.
Independent series are compared with side-by-side grouped bars.
Stacked bars represent additive composition across categories.
A small proportion set is readable in a donut.
Many parts are less misleading in stacked bars or, for hierarchy, a treemap.
Use a treemap only when parent-child hierarchy paths are valid.
One numeric distribution is shown with a histogram.
Box plots compare grouped distributions; histograms reveal a single shape.
Two numeric measures support a relationship plot.
Scatter remains appropriate; point size optionally encodes a third numeric measure.
Valid geography and a numeric measure support a symbol map.
Nested category paths support a treemap.
Ordered conversion stages support a funnel.
Source, target, and measure fields support a flow diagram.
Record detail is presented reliably in a table.
Rows, columns, and a measure support a matrix pivot.
Two dimensions and a numeric intensity support a heatmap.

negative_examples.question: Compare 40 product margins
negative_examples.reason: Many slices obscure precise comparison; use ranked bars or a table.

negative_examples.question: Compare department budgets
negative_examples.reason: Lines imply continuity between unordered categories.

negative_examples.question: Compare states by revenue
negative_examples.reason: A category and one measure do not provide two numeric axes.

negative_examples.question: Precisely compare five overlapping series
negative_examples.reason: Overlapping areas obscure values; use a line or grouped chart.

negative_examples.question: Show product family share of each region
negative_examples.reason: Use stacked composition only if additive segment totals are meaningful.

negative_examples.question: Compare carrier delivery medians
negative_examples.reason: Grouped distributions need box plots or a complete distribution table.

negative_examples.question: Summarize annual retention
negative_examples.reason: Retention is not an ordered conversion funnel.

negative_examples.question: Show current revenue
negative_examples.reason: A single scalar KPI needs a scorecard.

negative_examples.question: Show quarterly revenue trend
negative_examples.reason: Chronological trend needs a line chart rather than an intensity matrix.

negative_examples.question: Rank 20 stores by revenue
negative_examples.reason: A hierarchy is required; a ranked bar is clearer.
